faqs.question: Does the field app work without internet?
faqs.answer: Yes. The worker app is offline-first, so technicians and drivers can open jobs, capture photos, and collect signatures even in basements or remote areas. Everything syncs automatically the moment the connection returns.

faqs.question: How accurate is the live location tracking?
faqs.answer: It uses the device GPS to place each person on the map in near real time, with route history you can replay. You decide the update frequency and the privacy rules, such as tracking only during an active shift.

faqs.question: Can customers get a tracking link and ETA like the big delivery apps?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can send a live ETA and an on-the-way link over WhatsApp or SMS in Arabic or English. The customer sees the driver approaching without you building anything separate or paying a third party.

faqs.question: Will it connect to our existing orders or ERP system?
faqs.answer: It can. We integrate with your current order system, ERP, or e-commerce store so jobs flow in automatically and proof of delivery flows back. If you have no system yet, the app can stand on its own.

faqs.question: Do we own the app and the tracking data?
faqs.answer: Completely. You receive the source code, the database, and the documentation, with no vendor lock-in and no per-driver subscription to us. Your location and delivery data stays yours to keep and extend.
